Kildare County Council Leads as a Repower Region 
In 2023, Kildare County Council launched its Climate Action Plan 2024–2029, 
outlining a roadmap to create a low-carbon, climate-resilient county by delivering and 
promoting best practices in climate action. Building on this momentum, Kildare 
County Council is now leading Repower Regions, a prestigious three-year Erasmus+ 
Alliance for Innovation projects (see page 10). 
 
Libraries 
Kildare Seed Library 2025 was launched at the end of March in all our main libraries. 
Kildare Seed Library is a collection of organic and open-pollinated seeds available 
for our library members to use (see page 13). 
 
Kildare Arts Service Grants  
Kildare Arts Service completed assessments for applications for a suite of seventeen 
separate arts grants, commissions and bursary award opportunities and are seeking 
approval from Councillors (see page 14). 
 
Innovation 
Twenty-four staff have recently completed a Design Thinking Innovation Programme. 
Design Thinking is an innovative problem solving methodology that uses a five stage 
framework of defining and framing the problem, ideating, prototyping and testing 
solutions (see pages 17/18).

Affordable Purchase Scheme at Hereford Park, Leixlip 
   
The Hereford Park Affordable Purchase Scheme has now closed for applications.  A 
total of 247 applications have been received and the Affordable Housing Team are 
engaging with applicants (see page 19).

The Town and Village Scheme 2025 has recently been announced.  Advertisements

Integration  
Kildare LAIT organise regular drop-in information clinics in IPAS and BOTP centres, 
that allow service users to access Integration Support Workers on one to one basis.  
This has fostered strong relationships between service users, accommodation 
providers, and other services (see page 42).

The first phase of new bus shelter installations is being progressed to public 
consultation stage in April/May 2025 (see page 71).

Start-Up Business Advice Clinics run weekly for 1-1 confidential advice for start-ups.  
Throughout Q1 over 170 individuals availed of a business advice appointment. In 
addition, 32 individuals completed a Start Your Own Business Programme (see 
pages 84/85).

Kildare County Council Issues 
Advice to Tillage Farmers 
 
Kildare County Council reminds Tillage 
Farmers of the requirements of the 
Good Agricultural Practice for the 
Protection of Water Regulations 2022, 
as amended. Starting 01 
January 2025, the use of low emission 
slurry spreading (LESS) methods, 
such as trailing shoe and dribble bar

N/ha from grazing livestock manure.

Tenant Support Scheme 2025 
The Tenant Support Scheme is now 
open for applications. The closing date 
for completed applications is 16 May 
2025.  The scheme has been 
advertised on the Council’s website,

The objective of this scheme is to 
assist Local Authority tenants to carry 
out improvement work on their homes.  
The Tenant Support Scheme can be 
used to replace defective windows and 
doors, defective kitchen units or for 
other minor works.  Priority will be 
given to climate-action improvements 
such as new glazing, insulation, heat 
pumps, etc.  To be eligible to apply, an 
applicant must be a tenant of the 
Council with an up-to-date rent 
account.  Tenants can be approved for 
a grant of 90% of the cost of work up 
to a maximum of €5,000.  Details of 
the scheme are available on Kildare 
County Councils website on the
